completion_decisions: Retain the exact WR7, NREL 5 MW, nine-turbine, 14D-square, 4D-initial-spacing and ten-Fourier-mode target problem.
Use paper-linked revision dcb729f only as an unlicensed semantic and numerical oracle; independently implement the printed FLOWERS equations.
Validate the independently computed WR7 coefficients, initial AEP and analytical gradient against the paper-linked source.
Replace unavailable SNOPT with deterministic projected limited-memory BFGS using the same analytical gradient and 1e-3 optimality tolerance.
Resolve the random-layout grid conflict in favor of the paper's (N+1)-by-6 definition, corroborated by the current author-source correction.
Parallelize ordered O(N squared M) pair physics and gradient assembly using fixed slots and a persistent all-core C++ team.
Execute one deterministic target-native optimization and a separate N=500, M=10 H6 evaluation; do not invent repeated seeds.
missing_information: licensed SNOPT binary, version, full option state and solver basis
author optimization history, final coordinates, summary output and complete trajectory
exact pyOptSparse, NumPy, FLORIS, CPU and operating-system environment
random state and saved case lists for the two unseeded 200-case experiments
postprocessed Conventional-Gauss arrays used to evaluate every optimized layout

paper.authors: Michael J. LoCascio and Christopher J. Bay and Luis A. Martínez‐Tossas and Majid Bastankhah and Catherine Gorlé
paper.title: FLOWERS AEP: An Analytical Model for Wind Farm Layout Optimization

paper_source_conflicts: The paper defines randomized layouts on an (N+1)-by-6 grid. Paper-era tools.py uses (N+1)-by-(N+1); current revision 749303c changes y to six.
The author repository contains no license declaration, so it is an oracle and cannot be redistributed as platform source.
The paper reports proprietary SNOPT results without a solver state, history or final coordinate table; projected L-BFGS is the declared open replacement.
The 200-case source branches use the global NumPy random generator without a seed and do not publish the saved result pickles.

scope.claim_boundary: source-oracled flexible reproduction of FLOWERS model analytical gradient and native WFLO; not author source SNOPT trajectory FLORIS baselines randomized corpus postprocessed tables or timing replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: each of nine turbine coordinates is projected into the exact 14D square; Equation 45 has no pair-spacing constraint

decision_variables.resolution: two continuous Cartesian position coordinates for each of nine turbines

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: direct dimensional coordinates in meters with bound projection

initialization.resolution: 3 by 3 layout at x and y coordinates 3D 7D and 11D

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: initial and final FLOWERS AEP objective gain iterations gradient norm timing layout and hash from one deterministic native run

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize analytical FLOWERS annual energy production represented as a scaled minimization of its negative

paper_native_cases.resolution: WR7 nine NREL-5MW turbines ten modes one 14D square problem

parameters.resolution: D 126 m k 0.05 ten modes optimality tolerance 1e-3 feasibility tolerance 1e-4 and source-derived WR7 coefficients

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: projected-gradient infinity norm at most 1e-3 or 200 open-solver iterations; record combined AEP-gradient calls rather than EA FES

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: FLOWERS is analytical and has no learned model

update_order.resolution: evaluate fixed-order pair terms and gradient then perform projected L-BFGS direction and deterministic Armijo line search

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: nondimensional Jensen-based FLOWERS integral with ten WR7 Fourier modes and exact analytical Cartesian derivatives

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: WR7 one-degree WIND Toolkit distribution reduced to average speed per direction and represented by ten Fourier modes
